profile_text.body:
Twilio is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker TWLO, with CIK 0001447669. Its site describes a platform of APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, combined with conversational AI and identity verification. The company frames the offering as connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI on a single platform, with flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing.

Per its own description, the platform is built for what it calls the agentic era, in which humans and AI agents work together across channels. Twilio says its AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, hand conversations to a human when complexity or customer intent calls for it, and transfer full context so customers do not repeat themselves. The company presents these capabilities as building blocks for orchestrating context-rich conversations.

The company's litigation exposure record shows 281 entries in California, and no individual cases are named. No products or MCP servers are listed for it in the material reviewed.
